2121615325930176669.en_summary: $ASTS The future is orbital. Direct-to-device satellite broadband, wholesale to carriers: 13 satellites up, more than 60 carrier partners, and a backlog of about $1.3B. The guidance for this year stands, and the next step is its own launch vehicle, Blacklift, with a first flight targeted for late 2028. The case is a new network; the risk is the capital it takes to finish it.
2121615325930176669.zh_summary: $ASTS 未來是軌道的。直接到設備的衛星寬頻，批發給運營商：13顆衛星已上天，超過60個運營商合作夥伴，積壓約13億美元。今年指引維持，下一步是自有發射載具Blacklift，首次飛行目標2028年底。理由是新網絡；風險是完成它所需的資本。

2121615040575066402.en_summary: Chip group lacks full insurance coverage for damages stemming from the conduct of executives. Interesting angle, Side A only. Nvidia exposed to possible lawsuits after Jensen Huang’s downfall $NVDA.
2121615040575066402.zh_summary: 芯片集團缺乏針對高管行為造成損害的全面保險覆蓋。有趣角度，僅Side A。Nvidia在Jensen Huang倒台後暴露於可能的訴訟 $NVDA。

2121614863944372386.en_summary: $RKLB Own a piece of the space race. A launch company becoming a space infrastructure company: Electron flies regularly, Neutron's first flight is due in 2027, and the Iridium deal puts it in the satellite business at scale. Revenue beat last quarter; the long-term case is a second launch provider with its own constellation ambitions.
2121614863944372386.zh_summary: $RKLB 擁有太空競賽的一份。發射公司轉變為太空基礎設施公司：Electron定期飛行，Neutron首次飛行預計2027年，Iridium交易使其大規模進入衛星業務。上季收入超預期；長期理由是擁有自身星座雄心的第二發射提供商。

2121614525904404631.en_summary: $SPCX — Own a piece of space. Space, as a stock: Starship plus Starlink. The Ship reached orbit for only the second time this week and put 26 satellites up, with the first ever ship-catch attempt coming today. Reusability is a cost story — if the catch works, launch costs fall again, and the satellite business gets cheaper to feed.
2121614525904404631.zh_summary: $SPCX — 擁有太空的一份。太空作為股票：Starship加Starlink。Ship本週僅第二次到達軌道並放上26顆衛星，今天有首次船隻捕捉嘗試。可重複使用是成本故事——如果捕捉成功，發射成本再次下降，衛星業務餵養更便宜。

ticker_notes.SPCX: Starship軌道與捕捉嘗試，可重複使用降低成本

2121613915876630883.en_summary: $CRWD keeps AI agents disciplined. Cybersecurity for the AI era: more AI means more attack surface, and $CRWD sells the platform that watches it. It is the security layer of the compute thesis, and it grows with the same buildout that drives the chip names.
2121613915876630883.zh_summary: $CRWD 讓AI代理保持紀律。AI時代的網絡安全：更多AI意味著更多攻擊面，$CRWD銷售監視它的平台。它是計算論點的安全層，並隨驅動芯片名稱的相同建設而增長。
